entities.name: Choryu
entities.description: A talented but arrogant water wizard of the Minamo Academy on Kamigawa and secret agent of Minamo monitoring Princess Michiko Konda.

entities.name: Minamo Academy
entities.description: The academy on Kamigawa run by soratami masters.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: A princess who wished to leave Eiganjo and help her people.

entities.name: Sharp-Ear
entities.description: A kitsune mentor trapped by Choryu in water who later separated Michiko from Choryu.

entities.name: Riko
entities.description: A friend of Michiko in her party.

entities.name: Ichikawa of the Great River
entities.description: Choryu's patron spirit, who reprimanded him for taking Michiko from Eiganjo.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: Michiko's home from which she wished to escape.

entities.name: Lady Silk-Eyes
entities.description: A figure whose vision guided Michiko's party toward orochi country.

entities.name: Toshi Umezawa
entities.description: A character who disliked Choryu, saved Michiko from the Myojin of Life's Web and later freed Choryu from torment.

entities.name: Kobo
entities.description: An ogre's apprentice drowned by Choryu.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: The ogre who took revenge on Choryu for killing his apprentice Kobo.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: Faction whose revenge Choryu earned by killing Kobo.

entities.name: Myojin of Life's Web
entities.description: A spirit from whose hands Michiko was saved by Toshi.

entities.name: Shinka
entities.description: Place where Choryu was tormented and where Toshi shadow-walked to free him.

events.summary: Choryu helps Michiko escape Eiganjo, trapping their kitsune mentor Sharp-Ear in water, intending to bring her to Minamo Academy.
events.quote: Choryu took the initiative and helped her to escape

events.summary: Sharp-Ear escapes and separates Michiko from Choryu and Riko; Choryu's patron spirit reprimands him.
events.quote: reprimanded him for taking Michiko from Eiganjo

events.summary: Choryu and Riko reunite with Michiko in Sugi Hayashi and the party heads for orochi country, where they meet Toshi Umezawa and Kobo.
events.quote: The party met Toshi Umezawa and Kobo .

events.summary: Orochi attack the party; Choryu escapes on a stream, then drowns the immobilized Kobo with a stream of water, earning the Hyozan Reckoners' revenge.
events.quote: he drowned him with a mighty stream of water directed into his face

events.summary: Branded with the kanji marking Kobo's murderer, Choryu is lifted into the hands of Hidetsugu.
events.quote: Choryu was lifted into the air and brought into the hands of Hidetsugu .

events.summary: Hidetsugu tortures Choryu cruelly, binding him to a wall, poisoning him and burning him with a crystal while keeping him alive.
events.quote: keeping him alive all the time

events.summary: Shocked at Choryu's fate, Toshi shadow-walks to Shinka and tears the gem from Choryu's chest, letting him die in peace.
events.quote: finally allowing the ill-fated wizard to rest in peace

relations.note: friend, also secretly monitoring her for Minamo
relations.quote: He was a friend of princess Michiko Konda .
he was also an agent of Minamo and its soratami masters
he drowned him with a mighty stream of water directed into his face
The o-bakemono got revenge for his killed apprentice.
He tortured Choryu in an impossibly cruel and disgusting way

relations.note: disliked each other at first meeting
relations.quote: Toshi and Choryu immediately disliked each other.
